observation: The owner requests four explicit line classes and wants simplified elevations to remove decorative texture while preserving object boundaries, opening marks, dimensions, material labels, and recognizable source symbols.
cause: Dense customer drawings mix geometry, operation marks, annotations, and appearance texture; treating all lines alike creates unsupported components or noisy outputs.
proposed_rule: Classify each source mark as real_boundary, opening_operation, annotation, or texture_or_surface_detail before rendering. Use colorful or 3D references to support recognition without inventing geometry. Keep operation marks component-owned and omit appearance-only texture from the clean elevation.
evidence: user instruction in active drawing task
